issues.where: 题目 公式语法（整数字面量）
issues.problem_zh: 没说数字字面量可以用哪些字符、最长多少位。
issues.change_zh: 写明字面量只由数字 0–9 组成，不超过 18 位。英文版同样修改。

issues.problem_zh: 没说非法值抛 FormulaError 还是 CycleError 优先，也没说失败的 set 之后单元格是什么状态。
issues.change_zh: 写明非法值一律抛 FormulaError、不会是 CycleError，并且抛出 FormulaError 的 set 不存入任何东西。英文版同样修改。

issues.where: 题目 Part 1（get 的求值次数）
issues.problem_zh: 测试 p1_diamond_chain 和 lazy_no_memo 要求同一次 get 里共享的单元格只求值一次，题面没要求。
issues.change_zh: 补一句：一次 get 里，经多条引用路径读到的同一个单元格只应求值一次。英文版同样修改。

checked: ran page (both languages); printed timings match the prose (get ~450 ns on 2 vs 20002 cells, set ~4.7 us per cell of a 2000-cell chain)
replayed the statement examples on both LazySpreadsheet and Spreadsheet (35 -> 19, U1/U2 cycle stored vs rejected)

fuzzed parse_formula against an independent hand-written tokenizer on 300k random strings (33k valid) plus boundary cases (18 vs 19 digits, tabs, newlines, full-width digits, leading/trailing/double operators)

brute-force compare of both spreadsheets over 400 random runs x 150 sets (60k sets; 14.7k eager rejections, 254k lazy CycleErrors): values, CycleError exactly on cells that need a cycle, rejected set leaves contents/cache/both edge tables unchanged, edge tables equal the graph of current contents, each set recomputes exactly the transitive readers once
measured the lazy recursion limit: first failing chain length is 333 cells (page says about 330); 200-cell chain with 2^199 paths evaluates instantly thanks to the per-call memo
eager 5000-cell chain updates and rejects a cycle without recursion
